title: The Merkle transparency commitments are RFC 9162's, and a proof that does not prove is refused
note: Phase C. Each mutation removes one rule of agent_substrate/transparency.py: the domain separation of leaves and nodes, the split at the largest power of two, a bound on positions and sizes, the side a sibling is hashed on, the exhaustion of the path, the comparison of the old and the new roots. tests/test_transparency.py holds each with the CT project's published roots for RFC 6962's test leaves and with proofs offered for the wrong leaf, position or root.

mutations.name: TR1_no_leaf_prefix
mutations.rationale: a leaf and an interior node share a hash space: two children can pass as one leaf

mutations.name: TR2_no_node_prefix
mutations.rationale: an interior node is hashed like any 64 bytes

mutations.name: TR3_split_at_half
mutations.rationale: the split moves past the largest power of two below the size, so a smaller tree is no longer a prefix of a larger

mutations.name: TR4_empty_root
mutations.rationale: the empty tree's root is not RFC 9162's

mutations.name: TR5_inclusion_bounds
mutations.find:
if not 0 <= index < n:
        raise ProofError(f"no leaf {index} in a tree of {n}")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise ProofError(f"no leaf {index} in a tree of {n}")
mutations.rationale: a proof is built for a leaf the tree does not have

mutations.name: TR6_verify_index_bound
mutations.find:
if not 0 <= index < size:
        return False
mutations.rationale: a position outside the tree is verified

mutations.name: TR7_left_right_swapped
mutations.rationale: a right sibling is hashed on the left

mutations.name: TR8_size_not_exhausted
mutations.rationale: a proof shorter than the path its size requires verifies

mutations.name: TR9_proof_longer_than_the_path
mutations.rationale: a proof longer than the path verifies with its extra hashes

mutations.name: TR10_consistency_bounds
mutations.rationale: a consistency proof is built from nothing or past the tree

mutations.name: TR11_same_size_any_proof
mutations.find: return not proof and first_root == second_root
mutations.rationale: two equal sizes accept any proof

mutations.name: TR12_power_of_two_prefix
mutations.rationale: a first tree whose size is a power of two is never matched against its root

mutations.name: TR13_first_root_unchecked
mutations.find: return fr == first_root and sr == second_root and sn == 0
mutations.rationale: the old root is never compared: a fork verifies

mutations.name: TR14_second_root_unchecked
mutations.rationale: the new tree's right-hand subtrees are hashed on the wrong side
